title: Abelian direct-image acyclicity of a module K-injective complex
statement: Let Lambda be any commutative ring and v:A to B any morphism of schemes. Let U_A be the exact functor forgetting Lambda-module structure on small-etale sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-module-abelian-derived-direct-image-comparison]. If I is an arbitrary unbounded K-injective complex of Lambda-module sheaves on A [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], J is a K-injective complex of abelian sheaves on A, and j:U_A I to J is a quasi-isomorphism, then termwise abelian direct image v_*j is a quasi-isomorphism. There is no boundedness, flatness, properness or finite-cohomological-dimension hypothesis, and no assertion that U_A I is K-injective.

source.place: Tag 0D6J, lemma-modules-abelian-unbounded (3), proof using module and abelian K-injective replacements; equivalently the final resolution-normalization clause of Tag 0D6E

proof.text: Apply the fully proved simultaneous underived ringed presentation. Its equivalences send the module category and the two abelian sheaf categories to module categories on small sites, and its natural isomorphisms identify restriction of scalars with coefficient forgetting and the second direct image with abelian etale direct image.

The three equivalences are additive because they preserve binary products. Their termwise equivalences preserve K-injectivity and quasi-isomorphisms. Put j′ = alpha_I followed by eA(j). Apply the final resolution-normalization clause of ringedToposDerivedPushforwardComposition to the restriction morphism followed by the geometric morphism. It proves that the second module direct image of j′ is a quasi-isomorphism.

Cancel the isomorphism given by the image of alpha_I. Naturality of the direct-image comparison beta identifies the remaining map, up to composition with beta, with eB(v_*j). Cancel beta. The exact equivalence eB reflects quasi-isomorphisms, so v_*j is a quasi-isomorphism. This uses no claim that the underlying abelian complex of I is K-injective.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0D6J(3), 0D6E; explicit constant-ring presentation and termwise transport

lean.statement:
theorem moduleAbelianForget_kInjective_directImage_quasiIso
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {A B : Scheme.{u}} (v : A ⟶ B)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf A.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (J : CochainComplex (Sheaf A.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [J.IsKInjective]
    (j : ((moduleAbelianForget Λ A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso j] :
    QuasiIso ((((v)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map j)
